from collections import Counter


def _mode(values):
    return Counter(values).most_common(1)[0][0]


def _rare_mode(values):
    counts = Counter(values)
    return min(counts, key=lambda value: (counts[value], value))


def transform(grid):
    h = len(grid)
    w = max(map(len, grid))
    row_modes = [_mode(row) for row in grid]
    hline_color = _rare_mode(row_modes)
    hlines = [r for r, value in enumerate(row_modes) if value == hline_color]
    hline_set = set(hlines)
    body_rows = [r for r in range(h) if r not in hline_set]

    col_modes = []
    for c in range(w):
        col_modes.append(_mode([grid[r][c] for r in body_rows if c < len(grid[r])]))
    vline_color = _rare_mode(col_modes)
    vlines = [c for c, value in enumerate(col_modes) if value == vline_color]
    vline_set = set(vlines)
    background = _mode([
        grid[r][c] for r in body_rows for c in range(len(grid[r])) if c not in vline_set
    ])

    out = [[background for _ in range(len(vlines) - 1)] for _ in range(len(hlines) - 1)]
    selected = []
    for ri, (r1, r2) in enumerate(zip(hlines, hlines[1:])):
        for ci, (c1, c2) in enumerate(zip(vlines, vlines[1:])):
            corners = [grid[r1][c1], grid[r1][c2], grid[r2][c1], grid[r2][c2]]
            color = corners[0]
            if corners.count(color) != 4 or color in (hline_color, vline_color, background):
                continue
            out[ri][ci] = color
            selected.append((ri, ci, color))

    if not selected:
        return out
    top = min(r for r, _, _ in selected)
    bottom = max(r for r, _, _ in selected)
    left = min(c for _, c, _ in selected)
    right = max(c for _, c, _ in selected)
    return [row[left:right + 1] for row in out[top:bottom + 1]]
